title: Zesty American Grape Nut Pastry Bake
description: A creative twist on the American classic featuring the combination of grape nut cereal, sweet potatoes, and spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon canola oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-low heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sweet potatoes, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften.
Add the grape nut cereal and stir to combine.
Add the brown sugar and stir until well combined.
Add the unsalted butter and stir until melted and the mixture is smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with additional grape nut cereal if desired.
